about_the_game:
Meet Vivi and Dant. Join them on a heartwarming and empowering adventure in a Peggle-inspired game that offers exciting gameplay and a compelling story.



  • Exclusive original Lofi soundtrack: Enjoy a relaxing and immersive experience with the game's exclusive soundtrack.
  • Test your skills with more than 50 levels of increasing difficulty and challenge.
  • Beautiful hand-drawn graphics: Immerse yourself in a charming and whimsical world with the game's stunning hand-drawn graphics.
  • Captivating love story: Follow a heartwarming and engaging story that will make you think and feel.
  • Steam achievements: Unlock achievements and show off your skills to your friends on Steam.

short_description: A relaxing Peggle-like game with a cozy and emotional theme that will warm your heart, while you learn about love and self-respect. It's a relaxing Pachinko game for you to chill.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America
